Path 2, identityGOALS §3.6

SPIFFE / SPIRE

Short-lived, attested identity for every workload, including agents.

WHAT IT IS

SPIFFE is the standard for workload identity documents; SPIRE issues and rotates them after attesting the workload. The new SPIFFE Broker API extends identity to Kubernetes objects.

WHAT SETS IT APART

Replaces long-lived service-account tokens and secrets with certificates that expire on their own. Coinbase runs it across 79 production clusters. Our mesh can supply the same identity more cheaply.

WHERE WE STAND

Adopt, and start before the agents arrive: mesh identity first, SPIRE where the mesh doesn't reach.

"Every Kubernetes Object Deserves an Identity" (Defakto); Coinbase mTLS talk, KubeCon NA 2026
